posts.title: The flag is more often at half-staff
posts.description: For a few years now, I’ve had this vague sense that the U.S. flag is at half-staff more often than it used to be. This appears to be true. posts.title: The movie and the story
posts.description: I used to think Schindler’s List a beautiful movie. It’s a story of a man who is, fundamentally, an outlaw. He has little allegiance to the society around him; he is immune to the moral zeitgeist of the time; obeying the law is a matter of practicality, not conscience.
